title: UREA-SDS Quick RNA Isolation
author: Klaus Förstemann
materials: (all solutions added from this step on should be free of RNases as much as possible)
- dry the pellet briefly but completely.

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest cells by briefly centrifuging and removing the cell culture supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells or Process Flies
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample in extraction buffer based on the source material.

substeps.instruction: For cell pellets: Resuspend in 100 ul of extraction buffer by slowly pipetting up and down 2 times (or more until complete), mixing gently to avoid DNA shearing.
For flies: Sort into a microcentrifuge tube, chill on ice for anesthesia, add 100 ul of extraction buffer, and crush flies thoroughly with a 1 ml pipette tip.

steps.title: Incubate Sample
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample at 65°C for 10 minutes to increase extraction efficiency and denature nucleic acid duplexes.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA and Proteins
steps.instruction: Add precipitation solution and incubate on ice.

substeps.instruction: Mix gently by inverting the tube several times.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Separate the precipitate from the RNA-containing supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 10 minutes at full speed in a table-top centrifuge.
Remove the supernatant (~300 ul), leaving a small amount on the pellet to avoid aspirating precipitate or genomic DNA.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA from the collected supernatant using isopropanol.

substeps.instruction: Mix the supernatant well with an equal volume of isopropanol.
Optional: If using a small amount of cells, add 1 ul RNA-grade glycogen as a carrier before adding isopropanol to increase yield and pellet visibility.
Let the mixture stand at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Recover RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge to pellet the RNA and remove the liquid.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at top speed in a table-top centrifuge for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Wash RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet twice with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Mix and centrifuge for 30 seconds at full speed.
Repeat this process a second time.

steps.title: Dissolve or Store RNA
steps.instruction: Either store the RNA or dissolve it for immediate use.

substeps.instruction: To store: Keep the pellet under 70% EtOH in a -20°C freezer.
To dissolve: Add e.g. 20 ul of water; flick, mix, and wait 30 seconds. Repeat this process, then spin just enough to collect the solution at the bottom of the tube.
